skill.name: hubspot-automation
skill.description: Guide HubSpot CRM searches, record changes, pipeline tracking, ticket queries, and property management through Rube MCP and Composio.
skill.summary: Automate common HubSpot CRM workflows through current Rube MCP tool schemas.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All 68 shell-backtick alerts and three reconnaissance alerts are false positives caused by Markdown identifiers and normal CRM duplicate searches. The Rube MCP endpoint is a confirmed network dependency. Third-party OAuth access and CRM mutations without explicit confirmation create medium contextual risks.

remediation.issue: CRM create, update, and schema operations do not require explicit approval.
remediation.suggestion: Preview targets and changes, then require user confirmation before every write or batch operation.

remediation.issue: HubSpot OAuth and CRM operations depend on an external MCP service.
remediation.suggestion: Document data handling, verify the official endpoint, request minimal OAuth scopes, and avoid exposing authorization links or CRM data.

content.value_statement: HubSpot work often requires careful schema discovery, deduplication, and pagination. This skill guides reliable CRM operations through Rube MCP and current Composio tool schemas.
actual_capabilities: Checks current Rube MCP tool schemas before selecting HubSpot operations.
Verifies HubSpot account connectivity and OAuth status before workflows.
Searches, creates, and batches contacts while checking for duplicate records.
Searches, creates, updates, and reads company records in batches up to 100.
Searches deals, pipelines, owners, and support tickets with cursor pagination.
Lists, creates, and updates custom CRM property definitions.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP, Composio, and an active HubSpot OAuth connection.
Tool schemas may change, so operations require a fresh schema search.
Batch operations accept at most 100 records per call and larger jobs need chunking.
Provides no rollback and does not require approval before modifying CRM data or schemas.

use_cases.title: Import Clean Contact Lists
use_cases.description: Check email duplicates, validate properties, and prepare contact batches before creating records.

use_cases.title: Review Deal Pipeline
use_cases.description: Resolve pipeline stages and owners, then summarize filtered deals across every result page.

use_cases.title: Investigate Support Tickets
use_cases.description: Find tickets by status, date, or internal property while returning only requested fields.

prompt_templates.title: Find Existing Contacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Search HubSpot for contacts matching these email addresses. Return selected fields, duplicate candidates, and pagination status without changing any records.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Contact Import
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate these contacts against HubSpot properties, identify duplicates, and prepare batches of 100. Show the plan before requesting confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Review Deal Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Map pipeline and stage identifiers, then summarize open deals by stage, owner, amount, and close date across every result page.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Property Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect existing properties and groups. Prepare new definitions, flag immutable-name conflicts, and request confirmation before any create or update action.

output_examples.input: Find contacts matching the provided email list and report duplicates.
output: Found 18 matching contacts across two pages.
Two email addresses match multiple records and need review.

output_examples.input: Summarize open enterprise deals by pipeline stage and owner.
output: Open enterprise deals span four active stages.
Qualification has the highest record count.
Three deals have no assigned owner.

output_examples.input: Check whether a customer tier property can be added to contacts.
output: No property uses the proposed internal name.
Three enumeration values are ready for approval.

best_practices: Search current tool schemas and internal property names before every workflow.
Verify the HubSpot account, preview changes, and obtain explicit approval before writes.
Search for duplicates, limit batches to 100, paginate fully, and retain returned record identifiers.
anti_patterns: Do not expose OAuth links, tokens, or unnecessary CRM data in prompts or logs.
Do not use display labels where HubSpot requires internal property or stage identifiers.
Do not run unreviewed bulk writes or property changes without a scoped preview.

faq.question: What setup does this skill require?
faq.answer: Configure Rube MCP, connect HubSpot through OAuth, and confirm the connection is active.

faq.question: Can this skill modify HubSpot records?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents contact creation, company creation and updates, and custom property changes.

faq.question: How does it reduce duplicate contacts?
faq.answer: It searches existing contacts before creation. Users should still review ambiguous matches before approving writes.

faq.question: How are large result sets handled?
faq.answer: Searches follow cursor pagination. Create and update jobs are divided into batches of at most 100 records.

faq.question: Can it delete CRM records or properties?
faq.answer: No deletion workflow is documented in this skill.

faq.question: Why must tool schemas be searched first?
faq.answer: Rube tool schemas can change. Current schemas provide valid parameters and reduce failed HubSpot operations.
